viewing_check: Turn the rug over: check knots on the back (hand-knotted, even density) and foundation (cotton vs wool); look for a label or tag; check for moth damage, wear to pile, stains, odour and sun-faded patches; measure.
rate_note: All AUD, no conversion. Gowans prices are hammer, premium extra. Comps are Gowans room-size Persian rugs 285-320cm long: machine/flatweave types $300-570, genuine hand-knotted pure wool types $600-1,250.
